Meanwhile, I think--let me see--yes, I can give you this elegant pair of small-clothes. Put out my best,--the black ones. And now, Beck, I'll not keep you any longer."

arxiv-2109-03879.title: Emergence of robust memory manifolds
arxiv-2109-03879.creator: Tankut Can, Kamesh Krishnamurthy
arxiv-2109-03879.description: Abstract The ability to store continuous variables in the state of a biological system (e.g. a neural network) is critical for many behaviours. Most models for implementing such a memory manifold require hand-crafted symmetries in the interactions or precise fine-tuning of parameters.

arxiv-2112-11928.title: A Stochastic Bregman Primal-Dual Splitting Algorithm for Composite Optimization
arxiv-2112-11928.creator: Antonio Silveti-Falls, Cesare Molinari, Jalal Fadili
arxiv-2112-11928.description: Abstract We study a stochastic first order primal-dual method for solving convex-concave saddle point problems over real reflexive Banach spaces using Bregman divergences and relative smoothness assumptions, in which we allow for stochastic error in the computation of gradient terms within the algorithm.

arxiv-2202-10772.title: Gravitational Casimir Effect in Inspiralling Neutron Star Binary
arxiv-2202-10772.creator: Jing Wang
arxiv-2202-10772.description: Abstract Currently, the discussions and investigations for the vacuum energy is drawing great both theoretical and experimental attention. The vacuum states of variety of fields, subject to special boundary conditions, may contribute to non-trivial macroscopic vacuum energy, i.e. the Casimir effect, which become an interdisciplinary subject and plays an important role in a variety of fields of physics.

arxiv-2303-03660.title: ECG Classification System for Arrhythmia Detection Using Convolutional Neural Network
arxiv-2303-03660.creator: Aryan Odugoudar
arxiv-2303-03660.description: Abstract Arrhythmia is just one of the many cardiovascular illnesses that have been extensively studied throughout the years. Using a multi- lead ECG data, this research describes a deep learning (DL) pipeline technique based on a convolutional neural network (CNN) algorithms to detect cardiovascular arrhythmia in patients.

arxiv-2502-10300.title: Robust Pricing of Equity-Indexed Annuities under Uncertain Volatility and Stochastic Interest Rate
arxiv-2502-10300.creator: Ludovic Goudenege, Andrea Molent, Antonino Zanette
arxiv-2502-10300.description: Abstract Abstract In this paper, we propose a novel methodology for pricing equity-indexed annuities featuring cliquet-style payoff structures and early surrender risk, using advanced financial modeling techniques. Specifically, the market is modeled by an equity index that follows an uncertain volatility framework, while the dynamics of the interest rate are captured by the Hull-White model.

arxiv-2507-08692.title: Some notes on higher order concentration of measure Thanks: Research supported by GRF–SFB 1283/2 2021 – 317210226
arxiv-2507-08692.creator: Holger Sambale
arxiv-2507-08692.description: Abstract . This survey-type paper provides a common framework for a larger number of higher order concentration results (i. e., concentration results for non-Lipschitz functions which have bounded derivatives of higher order) in the spirit of [ BGS19 ] .

arxiv-2510-08928.title: LM Fight Arena: Benchmarking Large Multimodal Models via Game Competition
arxiv-2510-08928.description: Abstract Existing benchmarks for large multimodal models (LMMs) often fail to capture their performance in real-time, adversarial environments. We introduce LM Fight Arena (Large Model Fight Arena) , a novel framework that evaluates LMMs by pitting them against each other in the classic fighting game Mortal Kombat II , a task requiring rapid visual understanding and tactical, sequential decision-making.

arxiv-2512-03831.title: Spectral properties of the Frechet derivatives of stratified steady Stokes waves
arxiv-2512-03831.creator: Vladimir Kozlov a b
arxiv-2512-03831.description: Abstract . We consider stratified steady water waves in a two dimensional channel. Our main subject is spectral properties of the Frechet derivatives of steady water Stokes waves. One of main results is the absence of subharmonic water waves in a neighborhood of a Stokes wave.

openalex-w7204863209.title: AUTOMEDICAÇÃO E SEUS IMPACTOS NA SAÚDE DA POPULAÇÃO: UMA ABORDAGEM DE SAÚDE COLETIVA
openalex-w7204863209.creator: Roberto Kennedy Ferreira da Silva de Queiroz, Maria de Lourdes Machado de Resende Neta, Allyne Kelly Carvalho Farias, Yuri Monteiro de Oliveira, João Victor Oliveira Andrade, Ruth Micaelly Souza Maia

openalex-w7204863209.description: Esse artigo buscou analisar os impactos da automedicação na saúde da população, considerando os principais fatores associados, riscos e repercussões dessa prática no contexto da Saúde Coletiva. Trata-se de uma revisão integrativa e descritiva sobre a automedicação e seus...

pmc-11492490.title: Charting the course of Sargassum: Incorporating nonlinear elastic interactions and life cycles in the Maxey–Riley model
pmc-11492490.creator: Gage Bonner, F J Beron-Vera, M J Olascoaga, Stephen Palumbi
pmc-11492490.description: The surge of pelagic Sargassum in the Intra-America Seas, particularly the Caribbean Sea, since the early 2010s has raised significant ecological concerns. This study emphasizes the need for a mechanistic understanding of Sargassum dynamics to elucidate the ecological impacts and uncertainties associated with blooms.

pmc-11524676.title: Risk factors of cholangiocarcinoma in areas not endemic for liver fluke infection
pmc-11524676.creator: Tongluk Teerasarntipan, Pawat Phuensan, Chonlada Phathong, Somchai Pinlaor, Parit Mekaroonkamol, Roongruedee Chaiteerakij
pmc-11524676.description: BackgroundThailand has the world’s highest prevalence of cholangiocarcinoma (CCA), especially in the endemic area of liver fluke Opisthorchis viverrini infection. However, other regions of Thailand still have relatively high CCA prevalence.ObjectivesWe aimed to determine CCA risk factors in areas not endemic for OV infection.MethodsA case-–control study was performed at a referral center during December 2016–December 2017.

pmc-11564258.title: Ferroelectric field effect transistors based on two-dimensional CuInP2S6 (CIPS) and graphene heterostructures
pmc-11564258.creator: Maheera Abdul Ghani, Soumya Sarkar, Yang Li, Ye Wang, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Yan Wang, Manish Chhowalla
pmc-11564258.description: AbstractHeterostructures of two-dimensional (2D) materials comprise clean van der Waals (vdW) interfaces that can facilitate charge or energy transfer. Recently, the 2D ferroelectric CuInP2S6 (CIPS) has been integrated with graphene and other 2D materials to realize potentially novel low energy electronic devices.

pmc-12416185.title: Immunoglobulin free light chain-κ in association with NT-proBNP levels after smoking cessation
pmc-12416185.creator: Maki Komiyama, Swati Mittal, Hajime Yamakage, Noriko Satoh-Asahara, Hiromichi Wada, Akihiro Yasoda, Masafumi Funamoto, Yasufumi Katanasaka, Yoichi Sunagawa, Tatsuya Morimoto, Yuko Takahashi, Takeo Nakayama, Akira Matsumori, Koji Hasegawa
pmc-12416185.description: BackgroundSmoking induces inflammation in the heart and intima layer of blood vessels by activating nuclear factor kappa B, which controls the transcription of immunoglobulin free light chain (FLC)-κ. FLC levels are indicative of higher mortality in the overall population and poorer prognoses in cardiovascular diseases.

pmc-12768682.title: PP49 Differences And Inequalities In Drug Coverage Between The Public And Private Sectors Of The Brazilian Health System
pmc-12768682.creator: Elene Paltrinieri Nardi, Adriane Lopes Medeiros Simone, Ricardo Rodrigues Teixeira, Daniela Melo
pmc-12768682.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionAlthough Brazil has a public and universal health system, the Unified Health System (SUS), more than 50 million people also have private health insurance. This can generate health inequalities between citizens with and without private health insurance.

pmc-12832565.title: An Atypical Cause of Upper Gastrointestinal Bleeding in an Elderly Patient
pmc-12832565.creator: Hari Movva, Devin Garza, Minh Tran, Jing He, Sreeram Parupudi
pmc-12832565.description: Hyperplastic gastric polyps are typically benign and asymptomatic, often found incidentally during endoscopy. However, rare cases may present with bleeding, especially when polyps are large, ulcerated, or pedunculated. We report a 69-year-old male with melena and symptomatic anemia who was found to have a 3.6 cm ulcerated, pedunculated gastric polyp on endoscopy.

pmc-13240354.title: Respiratory Biomarkers: An Opportunity for Patient‐Centric Microsampling Approach for Treatment Optimization
pmc-13240354.creator: Ahmar Khan, Jacqueline L Stair, Daniel Baker, Neil Spooner, Darragh Murnane
pmc-13240354.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The clinical heterogeneity of respiratory disorders emphasizes the need for personalized approaches to prevention, diagnosis, and therapy. One approach to enhanced personalization of therapy is the identification of biomarkers for disease phenotype, severity, progression, and response to therapy. To date, several biomarkers have been developed for patients with respiratory diseases, and increasingly, blood‐derived protein and peptide biomarkers are under investigation for their potential to achieve better control over respiratory diseases by stratifying patients for specific treatment regimens.

pmc-13375757.title: Simultaneous onset of familial hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis and T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia in an adult
pmc-13375757.creator: Friederike Dierks, Finn-Ole Paulsen, Kai Lehmberg, Andreas Rosenwald, Carsten Bokemeyer, Katja Weisel, Christoph Seidel
pmc-13375757.description: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) is a severe hyperinflammatory syndrome. The familial form (fHL), associated with specific genetic alterations, typically manifests in childhood, while secondary forms arise due to triggers such as malignancies or infections. We present the rare case of adult-onset fHL in a 30-year-old female concurrent with T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia (T-LGL).
